title: The Over-Weighted Imprint (Memory Pattern Core)
description: The core mapping — handled with gravity — models the IMPRINT abstractly: a memory node stored with SALIENCE set near maximum, its alarm response intact, retrieved by a TRIGGER MATCHER with widened tolerance — so partial present cues ignite full past alarms. The formalism: salience W≈max, matcher tolerance τ wide, retrieval ∝ W × match(cue). As design material this is the AI memory that over-retrieves traumatic training data, the alert system that pages for echoes, the archive whose loudest file drowns the catalog. The model describes RETRIEVAL DYNAMICS — never persons, never suffering, never treatment. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. title: Trigger Matching: Fuzzy Logic
description: The matcher — the fuzzy — models CUE RECOGNITION with widened tolerance: exact matching (cue == imprint) vs FUZZY matching (similarity(cue, imprint) > θ, with θ low) — the wider the tolerance, the more of the present ignites the past. As design material this is search with the fuzz dial too high, the fraud detector flagging the innocent, the AI RAG retrieving on loose similarity. The design operation: TOLERANCE TUNING — precision/recall trade-offs made explicit, θ set by cost analysis (what does a false ignition cost?). Matching is a dial; the model teaches dial-reading. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

The design operation: DECAY SCHEDULES — deliberate, policy-set salience reduction over time (with carve-outs for what must stay loud). Archives need forgetting functions. title: Context Binding Failures
description: The binding — the context — models memory’s TIMESTAMPING: healthy encoding binds content to context (time, place, "this happened THEN"); the imprint model has WEAK BINDING — content retrieved without its timestamp, experienced as NOW. As design material this is the log entry without a timestamp, the AI context window that loses temporal order, the database with corrupted created_at fields. The design operation: BIND AT WRITE TIME — timestamps, sources, and context metadata encoded immutably with content. "When" is data; store it like data. title: The Present-Past Confusion (Temporal Logic)
description: The confusion — the temporal — is formalized: retrieval returns (content, t_then) but the system reads (content, t_now) — a TIMESTAMP OVERWRITE in the read path. As design material this is the cache serving stale data as fresh, the AI presenting training-cutoff knowledge as current, the dashboard showing yesterday’s numbers under today’s header. The design operation: READ-PATH VERIFICATION — every retrieval displays its timestamp; staleness is VISIBLE, never silent. Time-travel bugs are read-path bugs. title: AI Memory Safety: The Imprint Lessons

title: The Forgetting Function (Design Pattern)
description: The function — the forgetting — is a DESIGN PATTERN for systems: forget(item, schedule) — salience decays per policy; pin(item, reason) — carve-outs for what must stay loud (safety incidents, with review dates); audit() — periodic review of pinned items (is it still load-bearing?). The pattern’s wisdom: forgetting is a FEATURE — systems that never forget become imprint-archives, drowned by loud files. Implement in incident DBs, news rankers, agent memories, and team lore ("do we still tell that story?"). A Signature design pattern by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

description: The overclocking — the abstract — models a system run PAST its rated clock: all sensors hot, all thresholds lowered, performance spiky, hardware degrading — the machine can’t idle down. The design operation: GOVERNORS — hard limits on sustained clock rate, mandatory cool-down cycles, thermal monitoring (burnout metrics). Systems have rated speeds; respect them. The design operation: INTERRUPT MASKS — priority levels, batching windows, do-not-disturb as a first-class state. Attention is scheduled; interrupts are taxed. Abstract systems — never persons. title: Nightmares as Replay Loops (Abstract)
description: The replay — the abstract — models CONSOLIDATION LOOPS: the system replays high-salience content during downtime processing — normally with decay (each replay quieter); the imprint model replays WITHOUT decay (each replay at full volume). As design material this is the CI pipeline re-running the flaky test at full alert every night, the retrospective that re-litigates the outage weekly, the AI retraining on its worst examples disproportionately. The design operation: REPLAY WITH DECAY — scheduled, quieter, time-boxed revisits (postmortems have agendas and end times). Downtime processing needs volume control. Abstract systems only.
